logic.note: Runs the real compiled firmware on an ATmega328P emulator (avr8js): GPIO, timers, USART and interrupts behave like the chip.

timing.note: Cycle-counted at 16 MHz on a deterministic virtual clock, so delay()/millis() are exact in virtual time. Peripherals the emulator lacks (e.g. some timer modes, watchdog, sleep) and the crystal's ±50 ppm drift are not modelled.

analog.note: Pins are ideal sources with 25 Ω output resistance; inputs threshold at VCC/2 (no hysteresis). The ADC reads the solved net voltage against a 5 V reference; AREF, noise and input capacitance are ignored.

power.note: 5 V / 3.3 V rails are stiff sources. Per-pin current above 40 mA is flagged; total-package (200 mA) and regulator limits, VIN and brownout are not simulated.

emulates: ATmega328P CPU at 16 MHz via avr8js
Same pin map as the Uno
On-board L LED on D13 and ON LED
doesNotEmulate: RESET pin and the reset button
VIN, barrel jack and regulator limits
A6/A7 analog-only inputs (not exposed by the M0 backend)
testOnRealDevice: Total current from many pins (200 mA package limit)
Anything powered from VIN or the 3.3 V pin (50 mA max)
Analog readings near the input thresholds
